---

**Section.** Which part of
[the specification](https://drvelvetfog.github.io/source-review-coverage/v0.1): a field,
a parsing rule, a design rule (R1–R7), or §6.

**The question.** Stated so it has an answer.

**What an answer would change.** The predicate schema, the verifier, both, or only the
prose. A schema change is a new version of the type URI; say if you think it is one.

**Upstream.** Whether this belongs on
[in-toto/attestation#581](https://github.com/in-toto/attestation/pull/581) as well.
